title: Commitment Multiplier by Certificate Subscription Years
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts, for SSL/TLS Certificates subscriptions

The commitment multiplier of the late-issuance goodwill follows the years the new-subscription charge covered, as shown on that charge in the certificate billing history: three years take 1.2, two years take 1.1, and one year takes one. It multiplies the late-issuance goodwill figure.

- 3 years: 1.2
- 2 years: 1.1
- 1 year: 1

*Hypothetical:* a figure of $2.35 on a subscription whose new-subscription charge covered two years becomes $2.585.
